description: permissions.deny safety rules merged into project .claude/settings.json (0.17.0; --no-safety-denies leaves them out). A backstop, not a boundary: Bash rules match the command text from its start (and each subcommand), so variants such as `git -C . push -f` or a script reading a file itself are not covered here; workspace-core's safety check (lib/safety.mjs) catches more of them. Read rules also apply to Grep/Glob (best effort) and to cat/head/tail/sed in Bash. A deny rule wins over any allow rule, in every settings file. Template files (.env.example, .env.sample) stay readable.
